description: This file defines a Go package for declarative configuration of the MetricTarget type in Kubernetes autoscaling v2 API. It includes a struct with fields for metric type, value, average value, and utilization, along with builder methods for setting these fields.

methods.name: MetricTarget
methods.description: Constructs a new declarative configuration object for MetricTarget.

methods.name: WithType
methods.description: Sets the Type field in the configuration.

methods.name: WithValue
methods.description: Sets the Value field in the configuration.

methods.name: WithAverageValue
methods.description: Sets the AverageValue field in the configuration.

methods.name: WithAverageUtilization
methods.description: Sets the AverageUtilization field in the configuration.
